## What & why

<!-- One or two sentences: what does this change and why is it needed? Link the issue: Closes #… -->

## Type of change

- [ ] ✨ Feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] 🔧 CI / infrastructure (`ci:` / `build:` / `chore:`)
- [ ] 📝 Docs (`docs:`)

## How was it tested?

- [ ] Unit tests added / updated and passing locally
- [ ] `docker compose up` and booked a seat end to end
- [ ] Deployed to staging and `helm test` passed

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch follows `feature/*`, `fix/*` or `hotfix/*` naming and targets `develop` (hotfixes: `main`)
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] No secrets, passwords or tokens in the diff
- [ ] Docs / runbook updated if behaviour changed
